title: Fruits Basket: Another
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A sequel set at Kaibara High School, the school of the original Fruits Basket. Sawa Mitoma, a nervous girl who avoids people, starts high school badly until she meets two popular boys, Mutsuki and Hajime, who turn out to belong to the Souma family. The four-volume story follows her friendships and growing confidence (Yen Press blurb via AniList).
life_message: Being accepted by friends lets a frightened person find her own voice.
